mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_id, password, email, name, phone, birth, address, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{password}, #{email}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{birth}, #{address}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, profile_img = #{profileImg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE supplier SET cp_name = #{cpName}, cp_number = #{cpNumber}, cp_phone = #{cpPhone}, cp_address = #{cpAddress}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET password = #{password}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE name = #{name} AND phone = #{phone}
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE name = #{name} AND email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pw_reset_token (token, user_id, expiry_date) VALUES (#{token}, #{userId}, #{expiryDate})
